weaknesses.title: No SYS LISTDIR / GLOB — intake cannot discover dropped files
weaknesses.detail: Real artifact drops land under STATE/in/* but CubalC has no directory listing. Agents must pass ARG0/ARG1 or fixed default names (in/peer0.bits). Without shell ls, a generic intake worker cannot process an open-ended drop folder. Highest remaining shell-glue force for this use case.
weaknesses.repro: drop three unknown-named .bits under STATE/in; language cannot enumerate them

weaknesses.title: SYS SIZE miss sticky last_err with err_line=0
weaknesses.detail: Optional missing artifacts use SIZE/ISFILE probes that set last_err='path: missing' with err_line=0 empty err_src. PASS without CLEAR_ERR fails run -s. Every optional path needs explicit CLEAR_ERR ceremony.
weaknesses.repro: SYS SIZE "/no/such"; PASS; cubalc run -q -s → rc=1

weaknesses.title: SYS JOIN still absent from forms/search
weaknesses.detail: artifact_intake depends on SYS JOIN for STATE-relative paths; forms JOIN and search join still n=0 (iter7 W1 unfixed). Agents re-learn path join only from proofs or source.

weaknesses.title: No reusable subroutine for per-file intake — duplicated ARG0/ARG1 blocks
weaknesses.detail: FN/CALL exist in deep ISA/docs but not in human forms catalog for agents. Config-driven multi-file intake becomes copy-paste IF trees. Pain grows with ARG2..N.
weaknesses.repro: cubalc forms FN → typically empty; see duplicated path0/path1 logic

weaknesses.title: SYS JSON still one-key + re-READ; report plate cannot stamp accepted/skipped live
weaknesses.detail: Intake report is a flat DATE line; accepted/skipped/dig only in PRINT_JSON/VARS. Dynamic JSON plate still hard. Multi-key JSON from meta needs re-READ per key.
weaknesses.repro: INTAKE_REPORT.txt lacks accepted count despite LET accepted

weaknesses.title: No validation that .bits content is 01 alphabet before FOLDBITS
weaknesses.detail: ISFILE/SIZE/EXT pass for any .bits bytes; FOLDBITS still soft-accepts garbage (iter5). Intake type-route is extension-only trust.
weaknesses.repro: write hello to x.bits; intake accepts extension and FOLDBITS
